passages.heading: Miami Beach Born, Lauderdale Raised, Boca Raton Mayor
passages.text: Scott Singer is the Republican nominee running to represent Florida’s 25th district in Congress, the district where he was born and raised and has lived for 40 years.

passages.heading: Miami Beach Born, Lauderdale Raised, Boca Raton Mayor
passages.text: As Congressman, he will keep taxes and costs low, ensure strong borders and national defense, and cut waste, fraud, and abuse. He will work with President Trump and colleagues in Congress to advance common-sense solutions to improve our economy and protect our nation.

passages.heading: Miami Beach Born, Lauderdale Raised, Boca Raton Mayor
passages.text: Scott has a strong record of results as the three-term Mayor of Boca Raton where he balanced budgets while working to advance public safety, education, affordability, and accountability. Scott voted seven straight times to lower the tax rate to ensure Boca Raton has the lowest property tax of any full-service city in Florida. He was a political outsider who shook up City Hall and will fight for the interests of our residents against Washington insiders and career politicians.

passages.heading: Miami Beach Born, Lauderdale Raised, Boca Raton Mayor
passages.text: As Mayor, Scott led innovative efforts to partner for more classroom seats, improved school safety, and mobility solutions, while increasing accountability by streamlining and cutting red tape. Scott attracted strategic investment to add high paying jobs while cutting government costs to help affordability. He streamlined and cut red tape, while investing to ensure public safety and infrastructure are priorities.

passages.heading: Miami Beach Born, Lauderdale Raised, Boca Raton Mayor
passages.text: Now, Scott is running for Congress to deliver common-sense, America First policies that protect our families, our safety, and our future. He supports a term limits amendment, pledged not to raise taxes, and will vote to ban members of Congress from trading stocks. He will defend the U.S. Constitution and ensure unelected bureaucrats will not be able to impose their agendas on the American people. Scott will stand up to a radical far-left agenda that weakens our nation and threatens our important relationships with allies like Israel.

passages.heading: Miami Beach Born, Lauderdale Raised, Boca Raton Mayor
passages.text: Scott was born and first lived in Miami Beach before growing up in Fort Lauderdale. Having lived on the barrier islands for more than 20 years and in an apartment on A1A, Scott knows the issues facing condo residents like assessments, beachside concerns, and mobility. He graduated from Pine Crest School, Harvard University, and Georgetown Law. A small business owner, Scott has worked for two decades as a lawyer to also help businesses and entrepreneurs add jobs and overcome burdensome and wasteful regulations that raise costs.

passages.heading: Miami Beach Born, Lauderdale Raised, Boca Raton Mayor
passages.text: As the inaugural Chair of the America First Policy Institute Mayors’ Council, Scott leads a national group of mayors working to advance America First solutions and improve our cities. Singer has been active in a variety of nonprofit and leadership roles and has earned broad bipartisan support throughout his service. Scott has been a strong voice against antisemitism, and an advocate for stronger national security that safeguards our borders and protects our future. Scott’s family fled communism and he will stand up to far-left proposals to abolish prisons and federal law enforcement or private health care.

passages.heading: Miami Beach Born, Lauderdale Raised, Boca Raton Mayor
passages.text: Scott and his wife, Bella, are the proud parents of two children, and Scott is motivated to work for the next generation to ensure a better future for our community, our state, and our nation.

passages.heading: Jobs & Economy - A Proven Record of Strong Results
passages.text: Like President Trump, Scott understands what it takes to manage a successful business. Additionally, as mayor, he worked to support local businesses by reducing red tape, increasing the use of technology, and adding more high-paying jobs to our thriving economy.

passages.heading: Jobs & Economy - A Proven Record of Strong Results
passages.text: As our next congressman, Scott will work hand in hand with our local business leaders to build consensus on plans for sustained long-term financial growth for our South Florida communities.

passages.heading: Jobs & Economy - A Proven Record of Strong Results
passages.text: Scott supports the Administration's work to slash overregulation that burdens businesses and raises costs for consumers. As mayor, he advanced many streamlining initiatives to cut red tape and bureaucracy, increased technology use, and attracted businesses to bring high-paying jobs for residents.

passages.heading: Jobs & Economy - A Proven Record of Strong Results
passages.text: When in Congress, Scott will work to put into law the many gains from the Trump executive orders that are unleashing our economy so that our families have more opportunity and greater affordability.

passages.heading: Jobs & Economy - A Proven Record of Strong Results
passages.text: Scott supports energy independence to advance our economy free from destabilizing foreign influences and to reduce costs for our nation.

passages.heading: Respect the Rule of Law & Stand with Law Enforcement
passages.text: As mayor, Scott has consistently increased investment to ensure the best in public safety. While other cities defunded police and refused to prosecute, Boca Raton continued to have one of the highest starting salaries for police officers in the nation to attract and retain the best professionals to keep our neighborhoods safe.

passages.heading: Respect the Rule of Law & Stand with Law Enforcement
passages.text: Scott strongly supports President Trump’s efforts to secure the border and turn back the failed Biden policies that allowed millions of people into our nation outside of the normal vetting process. Singer knows that a secure border is reducing the crises from fentanyl and opioids that are ravaging communities and tearing apart families.

passages.heading: Respect the Rule of Law & Stand with Law Enforcement
passages.text: Scott stands with our local law enforcement officers who have come under baseless attacks by the radical left in recent years. He knows that public safety is the first function of government and deserves our strong support.

passages.heading: Respect the Rule of Law & Stand with Law Enforcement
passages.text: As a father of two young children, Scott will keep making sure our neighborhoods and homes are safe. He also wants to make sure our children are safe in cyberspace.

passages.heading: Respect the Rule of Law & Stand with Law Enforcement
passages.text: Scott has worked to ensure our police and fire rescue services attract and retain the best talent and have the necessary tools and resources to serve and protect our citizens.

passages.heading: Committed to a Strong Military and Defense
passages.text: As mayor, Scott ensured that funding went to public safety, not woke or race-based programs. As congressman, he will ensure that our brave military men and women receive the support and training they need so that America is prepared for any threat.

passages.heading: Committed to a Strong Military and Defense
passages.text: Scott will always advocate for policies that protect our military warfighters from being put into harm’s way and our nation’s collective national defense.

passages.heading: Committed to a Strong Military and Defense
passages.text: Scott stands with our veterans and will work to ensure that we take care of our brave patriots at all stages of their lives.

passages.heading: Scott Pledged to Keep Taxes Low and Has Delivered
passages.text: Scott’s core principles have always centered around keeping taxes low so that more money was in the pockets of American families. Scott has voted for multiple years in a row to lower the property tax rate, never voted for a tax-rate increase, and ensured Boca Raton has the lowest property tax rate of any full-service city in Florida. At the same time, Boca Raton has invested in infrastructure to keep other costs like water rates far cheaper than other cities.

passages.heading: Scott Pledged to Keep Taxes Low and Has Delivered
passages.text: Scott stands with President Trump on his work to provide the largest tax cut in American history and will oppose efforts to increase tax rates. In Congress, Scott will work to continue cuts of the incredibly wasteful spending like billions lost in the Biden years spent overseas on ridiculous programs. Fiscal discipline for America First means spending wisely to take care of our core needs so families keep more of their own money.

passages.heading: Advance Free-Market Capitalism & Oppose Socialism
passages.text: Scott Singer will work to help advance the America First agenda by sponsoring bills to make permanent President Trump's policies that are unleashing our economy and moving America forward.

passages.heading: Advance Free-Market Capitalism & Oppose Socialism
passages.text: Scott is a staunch supporter of President Donald J. Trump's leadership to cut waste and fraud from the budget. In Congress, he will work to help advance the America First agenda by sponsoring laws to make permanent the policies that are unleashing our economy and moving America forward.

passages.heading: Advance Free-Market Capitalism & Oppose Socialism
passages.text: Scott strongly supports the President’s strong response to threats from China, Russia, and Iran that have brought peace through strength here and across the globe. Scott has worked to advance skilled trades and manufacturing jobs to provide pathways to prosperity for millions of American and increase jobs. The America First economic and trade policy will restore the American Dream for generations.

passages.heading: Advance Free-Market Capitalism & Oppose Socialism
passages.text: Scott believes America is the greatest country in the world and will oppose all actions of the radical left to institute debilitating socialist policies here at home.

passages.heading: Standing with Israel & our Jewish Community
passages.text: Israel has had no greater friend than President Trump, and as congressman, Scott will work with the president to continue to stand with America’s strongest ally in the region and President Trump's bold efforts to prevent a nuclear Iran. Scott will advocate a strong national defense by ensuring we support our allies and stop threats that look to destabilize the West.

passages.heading: Standing with Israel & our Jewish Community
passages.text: At home, Scott worked to ensure safety for our houses of worship and Jewish day schools and will fight to expand existing federal funding for nonprofits at risk of terrorist or extremist attacks. He will continue to stand strong against antisemitism amid the increased bigotry from the extremes and will call it out, unlike Democrats who had two dozen members of Congress shamefully portray Israel’s response to brutal attacks on civilians as genocide. Harmful rhetoric makes our community less safe.

passages.heading: Cryptocurrency and Digital Asset Innovation
passages.text: Scott supports the ability of cryptocurrency to give individuals more control and transparency for how they want to store their money. Scott will defend your wallet, your safety, and your freedoms.

passages.heading: Increasing Accountability and Transparency
passages.text: As mayor, he has also championed reforms to increase accountability, ethics standards, and transparency in local government. As congressman, he will vote to prohibit members of Congress from stock trading.

passages.heading: Increasing Accountability and Transparency
passages.text: Scott supports banning American schools and universities who receive foreign funding for programming from receiving federal dollars.

passages.heading: Defending Our Communities and Constitutional Rights
passages.text: Scott has always stood with our brave law enforcement officers, funding to ensure the best police professionals, leading to a 25% drop in crime rates when he was mayor – from what were already 40-year lows. Scott stood up to challenge a law that could have had police officers responsible to pay for their own defense even when acting lawfully. At the same time, Scott will protect our Second Amendment rights against attempts to infringe on them. He knows that lawful gun owners deserve our rights and that we need to focus on stopping criminals, greater enforcement of existing laws, and more mental health treatment.

passages.heading: Infrastructure and Insurance
passages.text: Scott knows this district as a lifelong resident and as a mayor and the need for coordinated transportation planning along our nearly 30 communities. He will work for better federal solutions for our roadways, bridges, and coastline – something many residents feel was neglected by prior representatives. He will push to streamline the federal permitting process as he did many times as mayor, leading to savings of tax dollars and time.

passages.heading: Infrastructure and Insurance
passages.text: Scott will push for greater action by Congress to expand insurance programs that will save our taxpayers more of their dollars. This coastal district has unique needs for flooding and windstorms, and Scott will work to increase federal support to lower costs.

passages.heading: History of Service & Community Involvement
passages.text: Scott remains active across both national and local service organizations.

passages.heading: ABOUT SCOTT
passages.text: Scott Singer is an America First Republican running to represent Florida’s 23rd district in Congress. As Congressman, he will keep taxes and costs low, and ensure strong borders and national defense.

passages.heading: ABOUT SCOTT
passages.text: We deserve accountability from Congress and leaders who are interested in results more than headlines. Scott has a strong record as Mayor of Boca Raton where he served our community honorably for more than decade and got things done. He removed harmful red tape negatively affecting our local businesses. In Congress, he will work with President Trump to advance the America First agenda.

passages.heading: ABOUT SCOTT
passages.text: Scott has a strong record of results as Mayor of Boca Raton where he balanced budgets while working to advance public safety, education, affordability, and accountability. He led innovative efforts to partner for more classroom seats, improved school safety, and mobility solutions, while increasing accountability by streamlining and cutting red tape. Now, he is running for Congress to deliver common-sense, America First policies that protect our families, our safety, and our future.

passages.heading: ABOUT SCOTT
passages.text: Born and raised in South Florida, Scott grew up in Fort Lauderdale, graduating from Pine Crest School, Harvard University, and Georgetown Law. A small business owner, Scott has worked for two decades as a lawyer to also help businesses and entrepreneurs add jobs and overcome burdensome and wasteful regulations that raise costs.

passages.heading: ABOUT SCOTT
passages.text: As Mayor of Boca Raton since 2018, Scott has voted consistently to lower the tax rate to ensure Boca Raton has the lowest property tax of any full-service city in Florida. He streamlined and cut red tape, while investing to ensure public safety and infrastructure are priorities. He will defend the U.S. Constitution and ensure unelected bureaucrats will not be able to impose their agendas on the American people. In his time as Mayor, Boca Raton has attracted significant strategic investment as Scott has driven initiative partnerships to advance Boca Raton’s schools, mobility, and economy.
